aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab was created by Dominic Bonini, who made Village Foodie to find out which food trucks were coming to his village. It is a small company and he runs it himself.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.hatchgrab: The more food trucks I looked at, the more I thought they deserved better tools: something built for a business that is somewhere different every day, not for a restaurant with a fixed address. That’s why I started HatchGrab.
aboutPage.story.small: It’s a small company and I run it myself. If you get in touch, you’ll get a reply from me, not from a support queue.
aboutPage.story.village: I live in a village. Food trucks come, but without digging through Facebook I never knew which one would come and when.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: So I created Village Foodie — an easy way to see which food trucks are coming to the villages around you.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.advanced_reporting: Break down sales by period, item and event to see what is really selling.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Assign a buzzer number to the order when you hand out a buzzer, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen visible to customers that shows the order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map, so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each of them leads directly to its own ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types with separate prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to work with HatchGrab: a real-time kitchen screen, plus the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can prepare at once and how long it takes. Once a slot fills up, customers can’t choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital stamp cards — the stamps are collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into combo deals and offer add-ons at checkout to raise the average order value.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as WhatsApp auto-replies, but for Messenger and Instagram enquiries.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — at the front counter and in the kitchen — all showing the same orders in real time.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own accounts with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose signal, online orders stop, so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. With the iPhone, iPad and Android app you keep taking orders even without internet; the web dashboard requires a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment in advance when customers order online, via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a cut-off time for items that need advance notice.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You just review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically send customers an SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add the dates, places and times for each week and each event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item sold out with one tap — it immediately becomes inactive for customers.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock level — it goes down with each order, and at the end the item is automatically marked sold out.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, without needing a separate card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time from the free time slots, so demand is spread across the whole service (shift).
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the counter, paid on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run the service (shift) from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatic replies to WhatsApp enquiries about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can prepare at once and how long it takes. Once a collection time fills up, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron, on the tablet on the counter, on the laptop in the food truck — and on the card terminal you already take payments with.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, stable Wi-Fi and the same opening hours every week. But you are somewhere new every week, at different times, with patchy or no mobile coverage. HatchGrab was built exactly for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose signal, online orders stop automatically so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in the dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your posts on Facebook and Instagram
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Fewer queues and food that’s ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Built for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Messages on your WhatsApp get answered while you’re driving to the spot or standing at the grill — with your menu and your schedule. Soon for Messenger and Instagram too.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon messages on your WhatsApp will be answered while you’re driving to the spot or standing at the grill. Messenger and Instagram come after that.
